This page is the entry point to the aviation data ecosystem.

| Data family | Examples | Main use |
|---|---|---|
| Surveillance | ADS-B, Mode S, radar, FLARM, UAT | trajectories, traffic state |
| Communication/datalink | ACARS, VDL2, CPDLC, ADS-C | instructions, reports, intent |
| Flight intent | flight plans, route strings, NM models | planned trajectories |
| Aeronautical information | AIP, NOTAM, AIXM, ARINC 424 | infrastructure and constraints |
| Weather/environment | METAR, TAF, SIGMET, ERA5 | context and hazards |
| Airport/infrastructure | OurAirports, AIP, OSM | airports, runways, taxiways |
| Aircraft/operator | registries, type designators | fleet, identity, metadata |
| Performance | OpenAP, BADA, QAR/FDR | modelling and prediction |
| Safety/occurrence | incident reports, accident databases | risk and safety analytics |
| Maintenance/airworthiness | ADs, defects, reliability | reliability and constraints |

Each source should be assessed by producer, access, licence, coverage, uncertainty, and sensitivity.
